Package sootup.interceptors.invokedynamic

Class Fragment

java.lang.Object
sootup.interceptors.invokedynamic.Fragment
public final class Fragment extends Object
Code replacing one statement: a sequence of statements with forward jumps to Fragment.Labels. A label bound after the last statement continues with the replaced statement's successor. All statements get the replaced statement's position and exceptional flows.
